# Inline Message

**Figma:** Inline-Message (page 595:54502)  
**Import:** `import { InlineMessage } from "@zen/design-system";`

A Subtle-surface message placed inside the content it describes — contextual, persistent until resolved or dismissed.

## Use it for
- Context for a form or section ("You're editing production").
- The result of an action next to where it happened ("Domain verified").
- A summary of form errors above the fields.
- Theme Custom with your own visual (avatar, logo, thumbnail) for product announcements.

## Use something else for
- Page- or app-wide conditions → Alert Banner.
- Transient feedback after an action → Toast.
- A single field's validation → the field's error text.
- Blocking decisions → Dialog.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Theme | `theme` | neutral · info · positive · warning · negative · custom |
| Title / Caption | `title / children` | Body/Base/Bold · Body/Small/Regular |
| Icon / Visual | `icon` | theme icon (Content/<theme>/Light); a node replaces it; Custom takes any visual |
| Action | `action` | one Button/Main Small Tertiary |
| Close | `onClose` | icon-x-small-line, Content/Neutral/Light |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/inline-message.json`.

### InlineMessage
Figma Inline-Message (595:54857): a Subtle-surface message inside the content it describes. Padding Medium, gap Small, Corner-Radius/Large. Icon Content/`<theme>`/Light, title Strongest, caption Base.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | `"neutral" \| "info" \| "positive" \| "warning" \| "negative" \| "custom"` | — |  |
| `status` | `"success" \| "error" \| "warning" \| "info"` | — | **Deprecated:** Use theme: success → positive, error → negative (warning and info are the same).  |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Title (Body/Base/Bold). |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Caption (Body/Small/Regular). |
| `icon` | `boolean \| IconName \| ReactNode` | `true` | `false` hides the icon; an icon name or a node replaces it. Theme=Custom: the Visual slot (defaults to a 36px image placeholder). |
| `action` | `{ label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void }` | — | Figma Action: one Button/Main Small Tertiary under the text. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — | Shows the close control (icon-x-small-line, Content/Neutral/Light). |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | — | Accessible name of the close control. Default: the locale's “Dismiss”. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space | Run the action / dismiss |

## ✅ Do
- Place it directly above or beside the content it's about.
- Lead with the impact in the title, then the fix in the caption.
- Offer at most one action, phrased as a verb ("View plans").
- Keep the text Strongest (title) and Base (caption) of the theme; the icon carries the Light highlight.
- Use Custom only with a real visual (harness: inline-message/custom-needs-visual).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't render an empty message (harness: inline-message/needs-content).
- Don't stack several inline messages; merge them or show the most severe.
- Don't use Negative for a single invalid field; put the error on the field.
- Don't make essential information dismissible.

## Accessibility
- role=status; warning and negative use role=alert.
- The close control is a labelled button.
- Colour is always paired with an icon and text.

## Content
- Title ≤ 1 line; caption says what to do next.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inline-message/needs-content` | error | An Inline Message says something: a title, a caption, or both. | `zen-allow-empty-message: <reason>` |
| `inline-message/custom-needs-visual` | warn | Theme Custom exists for your own visual (avatar, logo, thumbnail); pass it via icon. | `zen-allow-custom-visual: <reason>` |
| `api/deprecated-prop` | warn | A deprecated prop still works but has a canonical name (onValueChange, onCheckedChange, checked, selected, level…); apps get a warning with the replacement. (App mode only; the repo migrates gradually.) | `zen-allow-deprecated: <reason>` |
| `copy/plural-count` | warn | Counts agree with their noun (1 item · 2 items): build the phrase with a plural helper, never `{list.length} items`. | `zen-allow-plural: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/action-without-handler` | warn | Repo examples, playgrounds and templates: every action does something when pressed. Flags a `Button` or `<button>` without onClick / href / type="submit" (IconButton: icon-button/needs-action), an action object ({ icon, label }) in leading, trailing, action, primaryAction, secondaryAction, subAction or actions without onClick, and pressable items whose list has no onSelect / onNavigate / onItemClick / onValueChange. Documented defaults pass: Dialog, ModalForm, SidePanel and BottomSheet actions close the overlay; a Menu opens from its trigger. Apps are not judged. | `zen-allow-action-handler: <reason>` |
